title: save() deletes the local copy that is still on offer, so S08.2's data loss is still reachable
claim: AUDIT-1 S08.2 fixed the autosave effect: `if (!hydratedRef.current || localOffer) return` keeps the offered copy untouched. save() still calls clearStoredDraft() unconditionally, which removes the same localStorage key. The comment at lines 163-169 promises that a copy on offer stays untouched until the user answers it. Save is the most natural next action after ignoring a banner.
failure_scenario: A closed tab left long unsaved text X in localStorage. The next day the banner «يوجد تعديل غير محفوظ محليًا» offers X. The editor ignores it, types a new sentence and presses «حفظ». save() removes X from storage, and the banner stays only as in-memory state. If the tab is closed or reloaded now, X is gone for good and no banner comes back. Autosave was fixed to prevent exactly this outcome.
suggested_fix: Guard the call: `if (!localOffer) clearStoredDraft()`. The autosave effect already skips while an offer is pending. The next load then re-offers X with the stale-base message.

title: Saving while a local copy is on offer leaves the offer pending and switches autosave off for the rest of the session
claim: The S08.2 fix stops autosave whenever `localOffer` is non-null, but `save()` never clears `localOffer`. `save()` calls `clearStoredDraft()`, so the offered copy is deleted from localStorage while the banner and the in-memory `localOffer` stay. From then on the autosave effect returns at its first line on every change. It does not write, and it does not remove the key. This brings back the S08.3 data loss (text typed and lost on tab close), and the banner still offers to restore a copy that is no longer stored. The same guard also means that edits typed before the banner is answered are never protected.
failure_scenario: 1) A previous crash left a local copy, so the document opens with the banner «يوجد تعديل غير محفوظ محليًا لهذا المستند». 2) Anas ignores the banner, edits a paragraph and clicks «حفظ». 3) save() inserts the version and runs clearStoredDraft(), but localOffer stays set. 4) He keeps writing for ten minutes and closes the tab. The effect returned early on every keystroke, so nothing was written and no copy is offered on the next visit. The ten minutes of text are lost. If he clicks «استعادة النسخة غير المحفوظة» instead, the old text silently replaces the newer saved text in the form.
suggested_fix: In save(), after a successful insert, call setLocalOffer(null) and setStaleBase(null). To also protect edits made before the offer is answered, keep the offer in state only and let autosave write under the normal key once it has been shown, instead of skipping while localOffer is set.

title: Saved documents that lack a whole group are never defaulted, so the form cannot be made valid
claim: load() uses the stored document as-is and applies defaultsForFields only when no document exists. The site_settings document that scripts/import-content.mjs:43 writes is { nav, footer, home, social }, with no `contact` and no `seo`. Both are groups with required:false whose own children are required strings (site-settings.ts:84-85). FieldInput's group case (FieldInput.tsx:610-626) shows empty inputs for the missing group and writes only the key the user touched. SettingsView tells the owner that SEO and contact are edited in this document.
quote: const loadedData: Record<string, unknown> = row?.latest_data ?? defaultsForFields(fields)
failure_scenario: The owner opens «إعدادات الموقع» (seeded document, no `contact`) and types only a WhatsApp number. data.contact becomes { whatsapp: '0501234567' } with no `email` key. schema.safeParse fails on contact.email. The list shows «التواصل: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined» in English (no Arabic zod locale is configured). The email input looks empty, so nothing looks wrong. After Save, savedParsed is still invalid, so canPublish stays false and «نشر» is disabled. The only way out is to type into the email box and delete it again, which nothing tells him. The same holds for `seo`.
suggested_fix: Merge defaults under the loaded data at load time. For example `deepMerge(defaultsForFields(fields), row.latest_data)` with groups merged key by key. Set initialData to the merged value so the form is not marked dirty. Optionally set an Arabic zod locale so the message is readable.

title: pullLines/bandLines must repeat a paragraph exactly, but nothing enforces it, so editing a paragraph silently drops its styling
claim: The header comment says each pull or band line must repeat a paragraph exactly. The public renderer matches by exact string (story/flow.ts:21-25, `new Set(pullLines)` and `band.has(text)`), and an unmatched entry is ignored. The admin edits pullLines and bandLines as free textareas, separate from the paragraphs. The schema has no superRefine, and admin-publish.ts:8-14 treats the schemas as the only publish gate. The invariant is tested only against the seed (tests/unit/design-b.test.ts).
quote: const BAND_LINES = { name: 'bandLines', label: 'أسطر على شريط ملوّن', type: 'paragraphs', required: false } as const satisfies Field
failure_scenario: Anas fixes a typo, adds a diacritic, or trims a space in a paragraph that the room sets as a large line or as a full-width coloured band. The copy in pullLines/bandLines no longer equals the paragraph. Publish passes, and the page renders that paragraph as plain body text. The band breaks and the display line disappears with no warning at edit or publish time. A pull line typed slightly differently from its paragraph fails the same way.
suggested_fix: Add a superRefine to each room schema. Collect every `paragraphs` array in the document and add an issue at ['pullLines', i] or ['bandLines', i] when the entry is not in that set. Or replace the free-text lists with a per-paragraph «كبير»/«شريط» choice.

title: Publish gate accepts a blank policy title and an empty policy body
claim: policyFields has plain required text/richtext fields. The defaults are '' and an empty root (FieldInput.tsx:258-279). richTextSchema accepts `children: []`. The Field type supports `nonBlank`, but it is used only for catalog tables (S11.3). The Zod schema is the only content check. commerce_policies_approve (20260927170000_policy_approval.sql:42-48) only requires that store, delivery and refund have a published seq. The policy page renders `policy?.title ?? POLICY_DOC_LABELS[id]` (policies/[slug]/page.tsx:56), and '' is not nullish.
failure_scenario: The owner opens the seeded policy `refund`, clears the text, saves and publishes. It passes the gate, and /policies/refund shows an empty h1 and an empty body with an empty <title>. The owner then approves the published revisions, and checkout accepts a blank refund policy as the revision the buyer agrees to.
suggested_fix: Set `nonBlank: true` on `title`. Add a superRefine to policySchema that requires at least one non-empty text node in `body`. Apply the same rule to the store, delivery and refund documents.

title: Unsaved drafts are keyed by document only: not per user, and not cleared on sign-out
claim: draftKey is `anasaq:draft:${collection}:${docId}`. AdminShell.signOut (AdminShell.tsx:68-71) does not touch it, and the editor route is not role-gated in the UI. The `operations` role cannot read content_versions or content_documents (owner/editor RLS only), yet load() reads the local copy anyway (line 144) and offers it.
failure_scenario: An editor drafts an unpublished post on a shared or lent machine, closes the tab and signs out. An `operations` staff member signs in on the same browser and opens /admin/content/posts/edit?id=<uuid>. RLS returns no row, but the form offers the editor's unpublished text under «استعادة النسخة غير المحفوظة», and one click shows it. The role boundary that RLS enforces is bypassed through the browser's local copy.
suggested_fix: Include the user id in the key, or clear all `anasaq:draft:` keys in signOut and when the session user changes. Skip the local offer when the row could not be read for this role.

title: A blank taxonomy label (and a blank post title) is publishable and reaches the journal
claim:
`label` is a plain required text with no nonBlank rule. getPosts sets labels.set(slug, taxonomy.label), and JournalList builds its filter buttons from the label strings. posts.ts:9 has the same gap for `title`, which JournalList renders as `

{post.title}

` and generateMetadata uses as the page title.
failure_scenario: A category is created with its slug filled in and the label left as the default ''. It is saved and published. Posts in it get categories ['', 'أخرى', ...], so JournalList (categories.length > 1) draws a filter button with no text. A post published with only its slug typed gets an empty <h2> and an empty page title. Nothing in the form blocked either.
suggested_fix: Add `nonBlank: true` to taxonomies `label` and to posts `title` (and `author`/`excerpt` if the journal needs them).

title: Menu items have no publish rule: a blank item is rendered and marks every page as current
claim: navItemFields has plain text fields, and the stored schema is lenient. SiteHeader renders every item with `key={item.href}` and `isActive(item.href)`, and isActive does `pathname.startsWith(`${href}/`)`. With href '' that is startsWith('/'), which is true for every page. The social links got a publish rule in C09 (isHttpsUrl, non-blank fields). The nav items did not.
failure_scenario: Anas presses «أضف عنصرًا» under «التنقل», gets { label: '', href: '' }, forgets it and publishes. The header shows a link with no name, and it carries aria-current="page" on every page. Two blank items also share `key=''`, which gives React duplicate-key output. Entering `journal` without a leading slash gives a relative link that breaks on nested pages.
suggested_fix: In siteSettingsSchema's superRefine, require a non-blank label and an href that starts with a single `/` or passes isHttpsUrl. Optionally require unique hrefs.

title: Each room's required «المعرّف» field is never read, so editing it changes nothing
claim: All four room field lists carry a required `slug` (lines 53, 83, 141, 209). A search of src for room slug readers finds none; the only `.slug` readers are journal, store and policy pages. The room routes are fixed. D40 lists the fields that stay (`signature`, `roomLabel`) and does not list `slug`. Nothing ties it to the document id either.
failure_scenario: An editor changes the started room's «المعرّف» from `started` to `begin` and publishes, expecting the URL to change. The page is unchanged. The stored slug now disagrees with its doc_id, and the field looks like a working URL control.
suggested_fix: Delete `slug` from the four room field lists and from content/initial-content.json (z.object strips unknown keys, so stored documents still validate). Or make it read-only.

title: Image and video id checks use `in`, so `constructor`/`toString` pass the publish gate (same class as S08.10)
claim: S08.10 fixed the room-id check with Object.hasOwn, but the field schemas still use `in` on the parsed JSON manifests, which inherit from Object.prototype. `'constructor' in imageManifest` is true. The public loaders parse with the same schemas, so nothing downstream stops it. images.ts:40 then does `manifest['constructor']`, a truthy function, and returns null, so no image is drawn. VideoTile.tsx:53 reads `manifest['toString']` and renders a broken tile.
quote: .refine((id) => id in imageManifest || isMediaId(id), { message: 'معرّف صورة غير معروف.' })
failure_scenario: An editor types `toString` (or `constructor`, `__proto__`) in an image or video id field. Both validation and the build accept it. The published page silently drops the picture, or shows a broken film tile, where the gate was meant to refuse an unknown id. Line 126 has the same bug for videos.
suggested_fix: Use `Object.hasOwn(imageManifest, id)` and `Object.hasOwn(videoManifest, id)`.

title: Repeated «أعلى/أسفل/حذف» buttons have no per-item name, and delete has no undo
claim: Every row of a list or paragraphs field renders the same three buttons (lines 649-675, 720-746). Nothing names the item: no aria-label, aria-describedby or heading. «حذف» drops the whole item, for example a stage with several paragraphs, immediately. Only an earlier Save or a page reload before saving restores it. X3.6 fixed focus after reorder but not the names.
failure_scenario: On the scenes page, with 30 photos, a screen-reader or voice-control user hears «حذف، زر» thirty times and cannot tell which photo it removes. A sighted user who mis-taps «حذف» next to «أسفل» on a stage with unsaved paragraphs loses that typed text with no confirmation or undo.
suggested_fix: Give each button an `aria-label` such as `${field.label} ${index + 1}: حذف`. Optionally add a confirm or a one-step undo for delete.

title: Image and video id checks still use `in`, the same inherited-key hole S08.10 fixed for room ids
claim: S08.10 replaced `docId in roomSchemas` with `Object.hasOwn` because `in` accepts `constructor`, `toString` and `__proto__`. The image and video id schemas in the same module keep the `in` test against plain JSON objects, so those names validate as known manifest ids. The images field is a free-text input with a datalist, so any typed string reaches the schema. Both schemas feed every image/video field: rooms, scenes, posts, product covers and the media form.
quote:
.refine((id) => id in imageManifest || isMediaId(id), { message: 'معرّف صورة غير معروف.' })
const videoIdSchema = z.string().refine((id) => id in videoManifest, { message: 'معرّف فيديو غير معروف.' })
failure_scenario: An image or video field is set to `constructor` or `toString`, for example by paste. schemaFor(...).safeParse succeeds and the document can be saved and published. On the public site, imageSources('constructor') reads manifest['constructor'] (the Object function), finds no derivatives and returns null, so the slot renders no picture with no build error. VideoTile gets a truthy entry with undefined width, poster and file and renders a broken player. The build never flags the bad id, which is what the 'Missing image manifest entry' guard is meant to do.
suggested_fix: Use Object.hasOwn(imageManifest, id) and Object.hasOwn(videoManifest, id) in both refinements (the public lookups in src/lib/images.ts and VideoTile.tsx can get the same guard).

title: Validation error labels drop the list index and the nested field, so the failing item cannot be found
claim: The X3.21 fix replaces the whole path with the label of `path[0]`. For list and group fields (rooms `movements`, `items`, `photos`; scenes `photos`), every error becomes the list label plus the Zod message. The item number and the inner field, which the old `issue.path.join('.')` output carried, are gone. The errors still disable «نشر» through `savedParsed`, so the owner has to search every item by hand.
failure_scenario: The scenes gallery has 30 photos and photo 17 has an unknown image id. The form lists «المشاهد: معرّف صورة غير معروف.» and Publish stays disabled. Nothing says which of the 30 items or which of its fields is wrong. Before the fix the line began with `scenes.16.…`, which at least gave the index.
suggested_fix: Build the label from the whole path: top-level label, then the 1-based index for numeric segments, then the nested field's label (walk `field.fields` for group and list). For example «المشاهد › 17 › الصورة: …».

title: pullLines and bandLines must repeat a paragraph exactly, but nothing checks it and a typo fix silently drops the styling
claim: The header says each entry 'must repeat a paragraph exactly'. classify() in src/components/public/story/flow.ts matches with Set.has on the full string. Neither the Zod schema, the publish gate nor the admin form links the two lists, and the admin shows no hint. Editing the paragraph without editing its copy in pullLines turns the large line into ordinary body text. An edited bandLines entry no longer breaks out as a band, and the following text stays in the previous block.
failure_scenario: The owner fixes a typo in the paragraph that is set as the large closing line of بدأتُ من هنا, and publishes. The old spelling still sits in pullLines, so Set.has fails and the line renders small. No error appears anywhere.
suggested_fix: Add a superRefine to the room schemas: every pullLines and bandLines entry must equal some paragraph of that room (message «هذا السطر لا يطابق أي فقرة»). Optionally build the two lists as checkboxes on the paragraphs.

title: Restore/discard buttons and other one-shot actions remove the control that has focus
claim: acceptLocalOffer and discardLocalOffer set `localOffer` to null, which unmounts the banner and the button just pressed, so focus falls to <body>. Same class elsewhere: MfaEnroll.tsx:83 swaps the enrolment form for «تطبيق المصادقة مفعّل.» after «تفعيل», and EmailView.tsx:90 reloads the attention list so a successfully replayed row (and its focused «إعادة الإرسال» button) disappears. None of these successes is announced (the MfaEnroll and EmailView results are not in a live region).
failure_scenario: A keyboard user restores the unsaved copy with Enter; focus resets to <body> instead of the form fields the restore just rewrote. After enabling the authenticator the form vanishes and the confirmation is never spoken, so the owner cannot tell that MFA is now on.
suggested_fix: Move focus to the first field (or the page h1 with tabIndex -1) after these actions, and announce the result through an always-mounted role=status element.

title: Reorder and delete buttons in admin lists have identical names on every item
claim: Every item in a `paragraphs` or `list` field renders «أعلى», «أسفل», «حذف» (lines 651-674 and 722-745) inside an unlabeled div, so a screen-reader user hears the same three buttons repeated for each item (a scenes list can hold dozens). The same shape appears in TeamView.tsx:186-214 («حفظ», «إيقاف»/«استعادة» per member row), VersionHistory.tsx:116-123 («استعادة» per version) and EmailView.tsx:201-208 («إعادة الإرسال» per row). AUDIT-1 fixed the equivalent problem on the cart (X3.11) and the team role select (S10.4) but not these controls.
failure_scenario: On the scenes editor a screen-reader user tabbing through 26 photos hears «أعلى, button» 26 times with no photo name or number; pressing «حذف» on the wrong one deletes a different photo.
suggested_fix: Add an item-specific aria-label to each button (`حذف ${field.label} ${index + 1}`, `استعادة النسخة ${version.seq}`, `إيقاف ${member.display_name}`), or make each item a role=group with aria-label.

title: number fields have no ceiling, so int4 overflow reaches Postgres and shows only «تعذّر الحفظ.»
claim: The shared `number` schema has `min`/`max` options, but no table config sets `max` and there is no default (the `money` case defaults to 10_000_000). Every number field in the catalog is a Postgres `integer` (max 2,147,483,647): `products.sort_order`, `product_variants.stock`, `low_stock_threshold`, `sort_order`, `coupons.usage_limit`, `shipping_rates.sort_order`. TableForm maps only 23505, 23514 and 23503, so SQLSTATE 22003 falls to the generic 'تعذّر الحفظ.' with no field named. This is the class S11.3 fixed for text/money fields; the integer fields were left out. Variants.ts:24 is one of the six sites.
quote: let schema = z.number({ message: 'أدخل رقمًا.' }).int('أدخل عددًا صحيحًا.')
failure_scenario: Owner types 3000000000 in «المخزون» (a typo with extra zeros) or in «حد الاستخدام» of a coupon. The schema accepts it (integer, >= 0), Save stays enabled, PostgREST answers 22003 `value "3000000000" is out of range for type integer`, and the form shows only «تعذّر الحفظ.», which reads like an outage, not a bad value.
suggested_fix: In the `number` case use `.max(field.max ?? 2_147_483_647, ...)` (same pattern as the money default of 10_000_000) so the form names the field; optionally set a sane `max` on stock and usage_limit in the configs.

title: Catalog text fields lack the control-character rule the database enforces
claim: products.title, product_variants.title, shipping_rates.name_ar and customers.name each have `!~ '[[:cntrl:]]'` in SQL. The client text rules are only `nonBlank`, `maxLength` and `pattern`; none rejects control characters, and `<input type=text>` keeps a pasted tab (only CR/LF are stripped). commerce-settings.ts already mirrors this SQL rule ('لا يُقبل نص فيه رموز تحكم.') with a field error, so the pattern exists but was not applied to the catalog forms.
quote: return field.nonBlank ? schema.refine((value) => value.trim() !== '', { message: 'لا يمكن أن يكون فارغًا.' }) : schema
failure_scenario: Owner pastes a product title copied from a table or spreadsheet, which contains a tab. The schema passes and Save is enabled. The insert hits `products_title_check`, 23514, and the form shows «تحقق من القيم.» without naming the title.
suggested_fix: In the text/textarea/slug case add a refine that rejects /[\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]/ (the same test as commerce-settings.ts) when `nonBlank` is set, or for all catalog text fields, with a field-named message.

title: Journal post slug has no length cap or first-character rule, unlike every other slug
claim: Products, taxonomies and `content_versions.doc_id` use `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,79}$`. The `slug` field type without a `pattern` falls back to `^[a-z0-9-]+$`, and `postFields` declares no `pattern`. Nothing in SQL bounds `published_documents.data->>'slug'` beyond the unique index, which fails only near 2.7 KB. The slug is used as the static route segment in `journal/[slug]`.
quote: const slugSchema = z.string().regex(/^[a-z0-9-]+$/, { message: 'يجب أن يتكوّن من حروف لاتينية صغيرة وأرقام وشرطات.' })
failure_scenario: An editor saves a post whose slug is 300 characters (or `-x`). The schema accepts it, publish succeeds (the index accepts it), and the rebuild has to write `journal/<300 chars>` to the export, a path segment over the 255-byte filesystem limit, so the build fails. The last good deployment stays live and the post never appears, with nothing in the admin saying why. At 3,000 characters the unique index itself raises 54000 and Publish shows only «تعذّر إكمال الإجراء.».
suggested_fix: Give posts the same rule: `pattern: { regex: /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,79}$/, message: ... }` on the `slug` field in posts.ts (and make that the default slug rule).

title: Content schemas accept blank nav labels/hrefs, taxonomy labels and post titles, and publish them
claim: S11.3 added `nonBlank` to the catalog fields, but the content collections kept plain `z.string()`: nav `label` and `href` (here), taxonomies `label` (taxonomies.ts:15), posts `title` (posts.ts:9). Only scenes captions and social links have a publish rule. `validateVersion` passes whatever the schema passes, and the public loaders parse with the same schema, so nothing stops a blank value from going live.
failure_scenario: An editor adds a nav item and saves it with an empty label and href (the default for a new list item is ''). Publish is enabled and succeeds; SiteHeader renders `<Link href="">` with no text, an unnamed link in the main navigation (WCAG 2.4.4 / 4.1.2). A taxonomy with an empty label renders an empty category chip, and a post with an empty title publishes an empty h1.
suggested_fix: Add `nonBlank: true` to nav label and href, taxonomy label and post title (the field option already exists), so publish is blocked with a field-named message.
